user_query: I was fired unfairly. What can I do?
variations: My boss sacked me for no reason
Is it legal for my company to fire me like this?
I was dismissed and I think it's wrongful
part_a_general_info: Under the Employment Act 1968, a wrongful dismissal occurs when an employee is dismissed without just cause or excuse. This includes dismissal on discriminatory grounds, to deprive benefits, or as punishment for exercising employment rights. Wrongful dismissal claims must be filed with TADM within 1 month of dismissal. If mediation fails, the claim is referred to the ECT. If your employer gave notice or salary in lieu per your contract, this may be lawful termination even if you consider it unfair.
triage_questions: Q1: When were you dismissed? (1-month limitation)
Q2: Were you given a reason?
Q3: Were you given notice or salary in lieu?
Q4: Do you believe it was on discriminatory grounds or to deprive you of a benefit?
Q5: Have you already filed with TADM?
branching_logic: If Q1 = more than 1 month ago → Flag as potentially time-barred. Escalate urgently.
If Q3 = 'yes, received notice' → Focus shifts to whether underlying reason was discriminatory/retaliatory.
If Q4 = discrimination identified → Additionally inform about TAFEP.
routing: Route A (Within 1 month, no TADM): Refer to TADM urgently. Emphasise limitation period.
Route B (Discrimination element): Refer to TADM and TAFEP. If union member, refer to union.
Route C (TADM failed): Refer to ECT. If above $20,000, refer to PBSG clinic for civil court.
Route D (Time-barred): Escalate to PBSG staff to assess if exceptions apply.
guardrail: Must NOT assess whether dismissal constitutes 'just cause or excuse'. General framework and routing only.
